newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kyrgyz foreign trade insurance company set up.
newsitem.headline: Kyrgyz foreign trade insurance company set up.

text.p: Russia's second biggest insurance company SAO Ingosstrakh said on Thursday it had become one of the founders of a new Kyrgyz insurance company Kyrgyzinstrakh.
The other founders include Central-Asia trust company Orient, and Kyrgyz state insurance companies Kamkor-S and Akzhol, Ingosstrakh said in a statement.

It said the chief goals of the new company was to set up an insurance market for Kyrgyzstan foreign trade, to insure foreign investment in mining and power sectors of the industry, and to cover building and ecology risks.
